children.value: Protect the hub: power up, mine the rocks, hold the line

Welcome to Tetherfield! You're dropped into an asteroid field with one job: keep your command HUB alive. To do that you'll build a power grid, mine the asteroids for minerals, and set up turrets to shoot down waves of enemy ships. New here? Pick 🎯 Campaign from the menu — it walks you through everything one step at a time. This How-to lives here as your cheat sheet whenever you need a reminder.
The core loop — make power, mine minerals
Everything you build runs on power, and everything you buy costs 💎 minerals. Here's the whole loop:

☀️ Solar — makes power. Your energy starts here, so build a few first.
📡 Relay — carries power across the field. Think of relays as wires: chain them to reach distant asteroids and stretch your grid outward.
🔋 Storage — banks spare power so you've got a reserve for when a wave hits.
⛏️ Miner — place it on an asteroid to turn power INTO 💎 minerals — your build currency. More miners, more money to spend.

So the loop is: ☀️ Solar makes power → 📡 Relays carry it → 🔋 Storage banks it → ⛏️ Miners turn power into 💎 minerals → you spend minerals to build more. Keep the grid CONNECTED — if the chain breaks, the power stops flowing and everything downstream goes dark.
Turrets — your four defenders
Turrets aim and fire on their own. Your job is picking the right ones and placing them well. Each has its own range and strength, so mix them up:

🔴 Laser — cheap and short range. Your go-to turret. Ring the hub with these to shred anything that gets close.
⚡ Pulser — fires fast. Perfect for swarms of small, quick ships.
🔵 THEL beam — reaches far, but it's WEAK against 💍 Ring ships (they shrug off beams). Great at long range otherwise.
🚀 Missile — long range and hits hard, but it CAN'T shoot point-blank. Put missiles BEHIND your lasers so they hammer far-off targets while the lasers cover up close.

The secret is layering: long-range 🚀 Missiles and 🔵 THEL beams up front to soften ships as they approach, 🔴 Lasers and ⚡ Pulsers hugging the hub as your last line. No single turret does it all — the mix is what wins.
The enemies — who's coming for you
Enemies attack in waves that grow tougher over time. Knowing each type tells you what to build:

🛩️ Fighters — a fast swarm of little ships. ⚡ Pulsers and 🔴 Lasers mow them down.
💣 Bombers — slower, but they hunt your modules. Stop them early with long-range fire.
💍 Ring ships — armored against BEAMS, so 🔵 THEL barely dents them. Use GUNS — 🔴 Lasers, ⚡ Pulsers and 🚀 Missiles.
🛸 Mothership — the BOSS. Huge and tough. Focus your heaviest firepower and make sure the grid keeps your turrets powered through the whole fight.
Can't stop a wave? It's usually a gap in your grid — turrets going dark because power isn't reaching them, or a flank left uncovered. Between waves, patch the network and fill the holes.
Controls

👆 Tap an empty spot — or drag a tool from the tray straight onto the map — to line up a build. A live preview (its shape, reach and links) follows your finger; nudge it anywhere to fine-tune, then tap ✓ to build (✗ cancels — nothing is spent until ✓). PRECISION TIP: drag from EMPTY SPACE and the piece moves a fraction of your finger — the farther away you grab, the finer the nudge (grab it directly for 1:1).
💰 Tap Sell to remove a building for a refund.
🔍 Pinch or scroll to zoom; drag to pan (use two fingers while you're lining up a build).
⏩ Tap Send to call the next wave early — do it and you'll earn a bonus.
🎨 Change the look anytime on the main menu — six skins: Medieval, Forest, Neon, Volcanic, Oceanic and Cats 🐱 — every building, enemy and even the tethers between them take on that world (in Medieval your farms feed the villagers who carry the power; in Cats… the final boss is The Vacuum), and your pick is remembered. Busy routes visibly wear in: ruts deepen, vines thicken, yarn frays.
🎯 A weapon's ATTACK range shows as an orange ring, so it stands apart from your build/connection reach.

🔺 Tap any building to UPGRADE it through GENERATIONS: Mk I fine-tunes, Mk II compounds, Mk III AWAKENS it (turrets gain splash, extractors tap a second deposit, generators surge when the grid is starved) and Mk IV climbs forever. Maxing a generation unlocks the next — evolving is pricier but transforms the building, and it visibly changes. You can also MOVE (drag anywhere, small fee) or SELL.
🔎 Tap ANYTHING to inspect it — deposits show ore left, enemies show what they are and how to counter them.
🛡 Shields now recharge only while NOT under fire — watch the bubble drain, flare, and breathe back.
⭕ Ring colours: orange = attack range, ore-coloured = mining reach, violet = support fields, glowing = power reach.
⚔️ NEW — THE WAR: the final missions add an ENEMY BASE. Build a Roost (Barracks · Warren · Fab · Foundry · Spawning Reef · Cattery) and it births fighters that march on the enemy base ALL BY THEMSELVES — they brawl whatever they meet on the way and grind the citadel down. You never steer them: build the machine, the machine fights. And mind its garrison — it sorties back at you.
📐 BLUEPRINTS: master a base, then pause → Save as blueprint. On any later mission, pause → Auto-build and your civilization rebuilds itself the way YOU designed it — backbone first, one piece at a time, as minerals allow.
🌍 WAR MODE: your bases are the nodes now. Assign each a blueprint — it builds itself the way you designed — then select a base, SEND, and tap the enemy. Zoom into any base to run it by hand (stronger), or stay zoomed out and command many (scales). Build mode is your workshop; War is where your blueprints fight.
🎖 UNIT CLASSES: your Roost breeds a MIX as it evolves — Swift skirmishers, Heavy bruisers, Siege base-crackers, Warden protectors. Composition beats raw strength: the mix your bases field IS your strategy, and world streams show their make-up as pips.

🔗 Only RELAYS carry power onward — they're the bridges (the branches/roots of your web). The core is the heart; everything else — generators, batteries, miners, turrets — just DRAWS from a relay or the core in range. So run relays out to reach far asteroids, and upgrade a relay to stretch its reach. Connections are unlimited — a relay feeds everything that reaches it.
Three ways to play

🎯 Campaign — start here. It teaches you step by step, introducing one new piece per level so nothing feels overwhelming.
♾️ Survival — endless, escalating waves. See how long you can hold out.
🧩 Sandbox — free build, no pressure. Experiment with layouts, power routes and turret mixes with nothing trying to blow you up.
Tip: power first, then guns. A beautiful wall of turrets does nothing if the grid behind it goes dark. You've got this — good luck out there!
